title: HitsPerPageSelector, when selecting the empty value, it sends `undefined` to Algolia
body: **bug** When using HitsPerPageSelector with no default value, an empty entry is generated. When selecting any non empty value, and then selecting a value, we get an error from the API: Reproducible here: https://codesandbox.io/s/8qo2m8n89 **Correct behavior** When selecting back the empty value, it should remove the hitsPerPage from the searchParameters. **Fix** Make `refine` accept `"undefined"` or `""` on top of the currently handled `undefined` (in the UI, we'll have strings, it's better if we don't have to convert). When the function receives those values, it should unset the parameter.
